Admin

Ops Console

How the fleet is doing, and the levers that work without shipping a release.

Checking your access…

This page is for Otian admins. Back to your account

Service
…

Whether the billing service is up and whether its configuration actually arrived. Each of these fails quietly when it is missing, which is why they are on a screen: no signing key and the app falls back to a licence check its owner can edit, and nothing else anywhere would say so.

Today's trial, against the limits that stop it. Both are circuit breakers, and a breaker with no gauge is one you find out about from a customer.

Fleet
…

Which app versions are alive, from each copy's daily heartbeat. Copies older than the first heartbeat release never report, so an empty list means "nobody has updated yet", not "nobody is running".

No heartbeats yet.
Levers
…

The remote controls every copy of Archie obeys within a couple of minutes. Leave a field empty to clear that lever. Nothing here can break a copy that cannot reach us: an unreachable lever restricts nothing.

Errors
…

Crash tails and restart loops, newest first, already stripped of secrets before they left the computer. Clear deletes the report; that is the whole triage system.

Nothing. The good kind of nothing.
Releases

The shipped record, written by the release pipeline. Releases happen in git, not here; this list is the receipt.

No releases recorded yet (the record starts with the first release shipped through release.sh).
